item.title: Valentine’s Day on US 280: Dining spots and couple-friendly activities
item.description: From Italian and steakhouse favorites to Thai cuisine, trampolines and charcuterie, U.S. 280 offers a mix of casual and upscale Valentine’s date ideas for food lovers and fun seekers alike.

item.title: Artist Vallie Pate offers heart collage workshop at Hoover-Randle Home
item.description: The workshop will be Thursday, Feb. 12, at the Hoover-Randle Home and Gardens.

item.title: Galentine’s Day shopping, sips and DIY fun set for Cat-n-Bird Winery
item.description: Friends are invited to celebrate Galentine’s Day with a full day of shopping, sweet treats, music and creative workshops at Cat-n-Bird Winery in Chelsea.

item.title: Jags honor signees on National Signing Day
item.description: Spain Park High School held a National Signing Day ceremony Wednesday.

item.title: Southern Energy Credit Union names 4 new vice presidents
item.description: Southern Energy Credit Union promoted four longtime leaders to vice president roles, strengthening its leadership team across member service, risk and assurance, marketing and lending.

item.title: Celebrate Valentine’s Day at Oak Mountain State Park with nature, wildlife and hands-on fun
item.description: Oak Mountain State Park is offering two Valentine’s Day experiences on Feb. 14 — one designed for couples and another for singles — each combining outdoor exploration, creative activities and close-up wildlife encounters.

item.title: High school soccer teams preview season at media day
item.description: Area soccer teams previewed the 2026 season at a preseason media day, with Briarwood, Chelsea, Oak Mountain and Spain Park showcasing experience, depth, new leadership and postseason ambitions.

item.title: Mardi Gras at The Summit to bring Bourbon Street vibes to 280
item.description: The Summit will celebrate Mardi Gras with live jazz, specialty drinks, shopping specials and prize giveaways along Summit Boulevard.

item.title: Great Backyard Bird Count invites families to support global conservation effort
item.description: Oak Mountain State Park will host a guided session for the Great Backyard Bird Count, giving participants a chance to identify local species and contribute data to a worldwide citizen science project.

item.title: Young Artist Space dance studio aims to teach identity, artistry
item.description: Lifelong dancer Alli Neeley opened Young Artist Space in Greystone to foster joyful, faith-centered training for girls ages 2–19, blending technique, confidence and creativity in a positive studio environment.
